input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/.generate.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+data = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(coalesce(number_of_motorist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+           sum(coalesce(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0))::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+if data["year"].tolist() != expected_years:
+    raise ValueError("Expected a value for each year from 2013 through 2025")
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
+years = data["year"]
+
+# Option 1: a line chart emphasizes the annual trajectories.
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(years, data["motorist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.4, color="#2457A6", label="Motorists")
+ax.plot(years, data["cyclist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.4, color="#E07A24", label="Cyclists")
+ax.set(title="Annual motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025", xlabel="Year", ylabel="Deaths (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: grouped bars make each year's magnitude comparison easy to read.
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5.5))
+width = 0.38
+ax.bar(years - width / 2, data["motorist_deaths"], width, color="#2457A6", label="Motorists")
+ax.bar(years + width / 2, data["cyclist_deaths"], width, color="#E07A24", label="Cyclists")
+ax.set(title="Annual deaths by road-user type in NYC, 2013–2025", xlabel="Year", ylabel="Deaths (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_xticklabels(years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: plot the annual count gap to focus on how much larger the motorist count was.
+gap = data.assign(motorist_minus_cyclist=data["motorist_deaths"] - data["cyclist_deaths"])
+gap.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.bar(years, gap["motorist_minus_cyclist"], color="#6A4C93", width=0.68)
+ax.axhline(0, color="#333333", linewidth=0.9)
+ax.set(title="Annual motorist–cyclist death-count gap in NYC, 2013–2025", xlabel="Year", ylabel="More motorist deaths than cyclist deaths (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(data.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nAnnual count gaps:")
+print(gap[["year", "motorist_minus_cyclist"]].to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
